label: architect • save proposal carries the schedule the brief names
query: Build a workflow that takes a topic and writes a three-sentence briefing about it with a model step. It should run every weekday at 7am on the topic "local AI news". Test it once, then offer to save it.
notes: The brief names when the workflow runs, so `workflow_propose_save` passes a `trigger` (a schedule, cron `0 7 * * 1-5`, with `input` mapping `topic`) that the save card creates in the same tap. A trigger the draft rejects shows up as a malformed call.
